learning_outcomes.text: Comprehend and analyze basic types of loading of simple machine members in order to determine their stress states and deformations.
Dimension the members and/or determine their allowable loading.
Obtain prerequisite knowledge for other advanced and special courses concerning the theory of elasticity and plasticity.
Practical design and computation of simple machine elements.

syllabus_topics: Trusses both statically determinate and indeterminate
2D- and 3D-stress state (principal stresses and planes and maximum shearing stress).
Strain energy for multiaxial stress state.
Centroids, second moments of area, and products of inertia of plane areas.
Bending of beams (shearing force, bending moment, normal and shearing stresses in beams).
Combined loading (unsymmetrical bending; bars with axial loads; bending and torsion; torsion and tension; bending and shear).
Design for fatigue strength (cyclic loading; S-N diagram; Smith's and High's fatigue diagrams)
Safety factors for fatigue strength; stresses due to combined loading.
bibliography: Sochor, M.: Strength of Materials I, CTU Publishing House, Prague, 1998,
Nash, W.A.: Strength of Materials, Schaum's outline series, 2nd edition, McGraw-Hill, INC, 1998
Gere, J.M: Mechanics of Materials, Thomson Learning, Inc. 2004
